snippet.title: Rudolph The Red-Nosed Reindeer - Video Game Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
🎄✨ His nose isn't the only thing lighting up this holiday season... ✨🎄
Rudolph and his friends are bringing a new, interactive adventure that'll have you dashing, gliding, and glowing all the way!
 
🎮 Coming to PS5, Xbox, Nintendo Switch & PC
🎁 Unwrap the official trailer now and start your journey to save Christmas!

A BELOVED HOLIDAY CLASSIC – NOW INTERACTIVE. Immerse yourself in the timeless magic of Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer like never before! Step into a vibrant, interactive winter wonderland filled with festive charm, playful exploration, and engaging challenges that bring the beloved holiday tale to life in a whole new way.
